visualCharacteristics.purpose: Section heading in a narrow left column with rich content (benefits, key-feature lists, fee/rate tables, steps) in a wide right column

contentPattern.structure: one or more rows: first cell holds the section heading; second cell holds the content (paragraphs, sub-headings, lists, tables, links/buttons). Extra cells sit side by side in the right column; with boxed-cards each is a bordered card (optional icon + heading header), with boxed-panel the right column is one bordered panel

reuseGuidance: Use for product-detail sections like Benefits, Key Features, Fees and How to Apply. Use columns-text for equal-width text columns and table-striped for standalone data tables.
